data.name: MainMenu_V1_Description
data.value:
## Supported games From [Imouto Ninshin](https://vndb.org/v2354) to [Netoraren'ai ~Ai Suru Kanojo ga Musunda Midara na Keiyaku~](https://vndb.org/v2354).
## Compatibility * Before [Princess Knight☆Catue ~Ochita Ryuuki Hime~](https://vndb.org/v5067): probably supported, but the engine was still in development, so a lot of stuff probably underwent a lot of changes. * After [Princess Knight☆Catue ~Ochita Ryuuki Hime~](https://vndb.org/v5067): supported, but due to how the engine was developed, which was probably done very poorly, some edge cases might not be fully supported.

data.name: MainMenu_V2_Description
data.value:
## Supported games Everything from [Kangokujou ~Ingyaku no Shihai~](https://vndb.org/v20364).
## Compatibility All of the features are supported, unless a new game has come out that offers a new encryption scheme yet to discover.

data.name: MainMenu_V1_INI_Description
data.value: The initialization file for the game doesn't really do much besides changing the game's title, since we don't have access to any debug feature.
data.comment: Options 2nd column in the main menu

data.name: MainMenu_V1_ODN_Description
data.value: The container files that store all of the game's assets. Some of them are encrypted, and it is hardcoded by what kind of asset they store.

data.name: MainMenu_Operations_Export
data.comment: Options 3rd column in the main menu

data.name: MainMenu_V1_INI_Export_Description
data.value:
### Description Generate a text-based .ini file in order to be able to make any changes to it.
### Input A game-ready system.ini file.
### Output A text-based [INI file](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/INI_file). It is important to not modify anything but the values for each respective key.

data.name: MainMenu_V1_INI_Import_Description
data.value:
### Description Create a system.ini file that can be read by the engine.
### Input A text-based [INI file](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/INI_file), generated from the *Export* operation.
### Output A game-ready system.ini file.

data.name: MainMenu_V1_ODN_Extract_Description
data.value:
### Description Obtain all of the files contained within an ODN container. When extracting them, make sure to take note of the characteristics of said ODN file if you are interested in reconstructing it back.
### Input A game-ready ODN file.
### Output Files included inside said ODN file.

data.name: MainMenu_V1_ODN_Create_Description
data.value:
### Description Create an ODN file with the given file(s).
### Input The files to compress, and the characteristics of the ODN file (obtained from the *Extract* operation).
### Output A game-ready ODN file.

data.name: ODN_EntriesOffsets

data.comment: Ask if the ODN entries offsets are absolute or relative

data.name: ODN_IsEncrypted
data.comment: Ask if the ODN to create is encrypted or not
